skill_name: Explain why freedom of the press is important
workflow: Freedom of the press is an essential part of a democratic society that guarantees citizens access to a wide range of opinions and ideas. It is a cornerstone of democracy that allows independent media sources to publish critical and investigative journalism, hold powerful people and institutions accountable, and provide meaningful public discussion.
